details:
I've read through suggested posts before posting this. My idea seems different.

Here goes!
Materials are part of vrchat avatars. They make up the visual design of them, and are very much needed. In vrchat there is a beautiful community who like to create models, or convert them using blender (pmx import).

This is where the problem starts. Draw calls by themselves are an inaccurate indicator of performance.

but it is not too hard to reason about how to determine the performance.

1. Materials are an instance either way. To render a material, the mathematical transformative model must be uploaded to the gpu (traditionally). This means all materials also require a setup not just during instantation of the materials, but also for each frame. You can imagine that if you have a thousand materials, there'll be a large delay right there.

2. Instanced materials are materials that run of a single mathematical model, despite the meshes swapping in and out. No matter how many materials there are added, there is no additional overhead per renderer.

3. Each distinct model causes some rendering delay (and thus lag or fps drop).

If we put it all together, I've come to a suggestion.

The most performance drops are caused because there are too many distinct materials with no instancing. So I was thinking of the following:
How about vrchat allows the configuration file to add a material limit?

This is how it would work:
you set the maximum amount of distinct materials. Especially curated instanced materials would be allowed. 

Once an avatar goes over the amount of materials, all the remaining render slots are replaced with a vrchat-specific cheap uniform instanced shader. 

This will reduce the draw calls no matter how many renderers you'll have. It will guarantee that anything beyond a set value will only take minimum performance off the gpu with minimum overhead.

What does this mean to others?
It means that some models will appear sort of blank due to the replaced materials. The alternative is that there's massive lag making the game unplayable. By this approach the gist of the model is preserved without having to block the people altogether.

While we're at it, I'd say 7 materials should be a max, and put up a tutorial how to do atlassing in a free artistic 3d modeling tool, like blender.

TOO LONG DIDN'T READ:
Limit the amount of materials when it goes over a certain limit, and replace all remaining materials with a lightweight instanced version of a general vrchat one. (Perhaps a transparent one?)

Thanks!
title: UI material limit option
